verdict.line: You lose if you let Garen's Perseverance tick between trades and short-trade him for free; you win if you bank Fury past 50 and all-in the moment W or R is up.

brief.thesis: This is a 48.5% coinflip over 787 games because both champions are cooldown-driven brawlers, but Renekton's Fury threshold is the deciding variable: below 50 Fury he is just a weaker Garen, above it his W becomes a 3-hit, shield-destroying 1.5s stun that Garen has no equivalent answer to. Garen's real defense isn't his kit, it's his passive — Perseverance heals him back to full between skirmishes if you let him disengage clean, which is why OP.GG's own tip is to never stop hitting him.

theirWindow.when: Right after he lands Q, level 2+
theirWindow.what: Decisive Strike gives Garen a burst of Move Speed that breaks any slow on him and silences you on his next hit — don't extend a trade or try to Flash-stick him inside its 8s cooldown window, back off and let it go on cooldown first.

yourWindow.when: Fury above 50 with W or E off cooldown
yourWindow.what: Cast Ruthless Predator (W) for the 3-slash version — it strips any shield he has up and stuns for 1.5s instead of 0.75s. Chain into Slice and Dice (E) for the armor-shred version to guarantee the follow-up trade lands harder.

start.why: Most-picked start in this matchup (84.9% pick, 48.5% WR over 845 games) — the extra sustain and AD let you match Garen's short-cooldown poke without losing the wave.

boots.why: 80.2% pick, 48.1% WR over 763 games — flat physical damage reduction blunts Garen's auto-attack resets and Judgment spin in extended trades.

core.why: The shield-and-burst proc lines up with your empowered W all-in window, letting you punch through Garen's passive regen in one exchange.

runes.keystoneWhy: Conqueror rewards exactly the OP.GG mandate — attack Garen constantly. Stacking it during extended trades both denies his Perseverance window and gives you healing to offset his Courage damage aura.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is run in 87.4% of games at 47.9% WR and matches the aggressive, solo-kill-favored shape of this matchup — Ignite denies Perseverance's regen tick during your all-in window and secures kills your empowered W sets up.

playing.title: Never let him disengage clean
playing.detail: Perseverance only activates if Garen hasn't taken damage recently — walk up and land at least one auto or Q every time he tries to reset, even if it's not a full trade.

playing.title: Bank Fury before committing W
playing.detail: Hold Ruthless Predator until Fury exceeds 50 so it fires the 3-slash version — it destroys shields and stuns for 1.5s instead of 0.75s, which is the difference between a poke and a kill.

playing.title: Respect the Q silence window
playing.detail: After level 2, expect Decisive Strike to break your slows and silence you on his next hit. Don't extend trades inside its 8s cooldown unless you're ready to eat the silence.

playing.title: Use E to control spacing around his spin
playing.detail: Slice and Dice has a 450 range dash — use it to close or reset distance around Garen's Judgment spin, especially early when his E is still on a 13s cooldown.

playing.title: All-in the instant R is up
playing.detail: Dominus grants bonus health and periodic Fury generation on a 120s cooldown at rank 1 — this is your biggest advantage window and lines up with your measured solo-kill edge in this matchup.

playing.title: Track his R cooldown after level 6
playing.detail: Demacian Justice executes at 400 range and starts at a 140s cooldown, but it drops to 50-20s with takedowns — don't overextend low on health once he's picked up kills or assists.

playing.title: Front-load Eclipse for the burst window
playing.detail: Eclipse's proc synergizes with your empowered W stun to punch through his passive sustain in a single trade rather than trading it away over several short pokes.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, rune pages, summoner spells, and all win rates above are measured from real games on the current patch (16.18.1) via OP.GG; the mechanical reasoning and trade/timing advice are my own analysis layered on top of that data.
